product.olivetti-m380-c.summary: The compact M380 housed one internal hard disk.
product.olivetti-m380-c.history: Olivetti announced the M380/C in 1987 as a compact desktop 386 for standalone or networked workstations. In April 1988, Computerwoche described the XP1 as a faster development of the M380/C.
product.olivetti-m380-c.architecture: RAM was expanded with cards. The brochure describes a configuration up to 36 MB, and the guide and Computerwoche list up to 48 MB. The brochure offers a 63 MB disk where Computerwoche lists 62 MB.
product.olivetti-m380-c.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m380-c.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m380-c.service: Olivetti, Pocket Service Guide, vol. I, §7.
product.olivetti-m380-c.press87: Computerwoche, 3 July 1987, Neue PC-Familie nach altem Standard.
product.olivetti-m380-c.press88: Computerwoche, 29 April 1988, Olivetti bringt 80386er auf den Markt.
